# SlideToConfirm

Slide-to-confirm for deliberate, irreversible actions (merge to main, send to a client).

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.SlideToConfirm` · 09 Forms

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.SlideToConfirm label="…" onConfirm={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.SlideToConfirm" label="…" on-confirm="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Slide to confirm (Bencho "sld", web/src ui.tsx). 56px pill track, 48px ink grip; drag past 90% to commit, release early to spring back (500ms settle). Keyboard: Enter/Space commits, → steps a quarter, ←/Esc resets. Use for irreversible, deliberate actions (merge to main, send to a client, run on production).
